linux-gfx90a.blocked_reason: All compute kernels are hand-written NVIDIA tensor-core + async PTX (mma.sync/ldmatrix/wgmma/cp.async) with the 32-lane MMA fragment layout baked into smem addressing and softmax shuffle reductions; no portable path, no hipify translation. Correct gfx90a needs an AMD-native MFMA (rocWMMA/CK) reimplementation of ~7k LOC of attention kernels; FP8 (sm89/sm90) has no gfx90a matrix HW. Reimplement-not-port, deferred. See plan.md.

not_portable.reason: Every compute kernel is hand-written NVIDIA tensor-core and async PTX (mma.sync, ldmatrix, wgmma, cp.async) with the 32-lane MMA fragment layout baked into the algorithm, so there is nothing to translate.
